Paid into pillar 3a in 2026: 3'300.00 of the maximum 7'258.00; after the standing orders 3'658.00 is missing.
6 payments of together 3'155.45 are due in the next 30 days.
Regular payments that cost more within a year: KPT Krankenkasse AG from 296.80 to 399.40 on 24.12.2025.

Spending averaged 5'511.93 a month over the last 6 months, highest in 2026-06.
6 payments of together 3'155.45 leave before the salary on 24.12.2026.
The 6 largest monthly payments add up to 2'103.25 a month.

titles.reason: Titles are short, read naturally (e.g. "What is left after all bills are paid", "Pillar 3a, 2026") and each accurately names what its tile shows.

not_empty_or_repeated.reason: No tile is empty, zero or pointless, and the single tax bill standing beside the 30-days list is the detail-beside-the-list pattern the rubric explicitly permits; no other pair of tiles shows the same thing.

coherent.reason: The board tells one followable story of Jana's monthly money — little left after bills, what is due soon including the large tax bill, and what she is building with the emergency fund and pillar 3a — matching her guiding question of what she can afford and how she builds something up.
